name: @lexora/buddy
description: Lexora Desktop with a local Codex runtime and desktop pet

scripts.build:electron: pnpm build:runtime:release && vue-tsc -b --pretty false && electron-vite build
scripts.build:runtime: cargo build --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --bin lexora-buddy-runtime && cargo build --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features pet --bin lexora-buddy-pet
scripts.build:runtime:release: cargo build --release --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --bin lexora-buddy-runtime && cargo build --release --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features pet --bin lexora-buddy-pet
scripts.package:full: pnpm build:electron && pnpm verify:pet-boundary && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux deb && node ../../packaging/buddy/release/verify-deb-dependencies.mjs
